usageNotes: Use this to discover available tags for an OCI container image repository before pulling or deploying a container (e.g., when creating an LXC from an OCI image). The `reference` must be a valid OCI repository path without a tag or digest (e.g., `docker.io/library/debian` or a private registry path); the node performs the remote registry query outbound, so it must have network access to the registry. Requires `Sys.AccessNetwork` on the node — API tokens are supported.

examples.summary: List all available tags for the official Debian image on Docker Hub

tips: The reference pattern does not allow a tag suffix (no `:latest`) — pass only the repository path.
If the registry requires authentication, configure registry credentials on the node before calling this endpoint.
Large public registries (Docker Hub) may rate-limit unauthenticated tag-list requests; use a pull-through cache or authenticated token to avoid 429 errors.
The response is a flat string array of tag names; sort or filter client-side as needed.
